title: 12 倒计时12
content_zh:
倪夏将睡未睡，意识正在清醒和模糊之间游离时，枕边手机震动一下，将她的睡意驱赶了大半。
蜀境的宫保鸡丁、海岱楼的一品豆腐、徽韵轩的问政山笋、淮扬晓宴的八宝饭……
第二天清晨，倪夏踩着湿润的地面，从地面停车场走到了江城展览中心入口处。
江城电影制播年会将在这里举办开幕式，谷雨声从朋友那里搞到了入场券，两人打算一起混进去碰碰运气。
毕竟这种场合行业巨头云集，都在这里互通有无，说不定能有天降机遇。
倪夏得意地扬眉，和谷雨声并肩往里走去，“还给自己磨了杯咖啡。”
“如果接下来没什么意外的话，爷爷这三百万还能保我好一阵的睡眠质量。”
倪夏一时没听懂，疑惑地“啊”了一声，才反应过来她嘴里的“老公”是指谁。
转头对上谷雨声的眼神，才心领神会地低喃道：“谁躺在五千万的怀里会睡不好呢。”
望着面前巨大的签到墙，谷雨声挑挑眉，“不着急，毕竟他只是plan B。”
谷雨声倒是毫不露怯，她本就是大高个，穿了条衬衫裙，拿着签名笔往那儿一站当真像个电影公司的年轻老板。
有这气势在，现场工作人员也没敢怠慢她们，客客气气地把他们引进了会议大厅。
亘古不变的领导致辞，行业成果展示，再来点战略合作签约仪式，磨磨蹭蹭就是两个多小时。
倪夏和谷雨声又坐在最角落的位置，四周都是负责开幕式的工作人员，根本接触不到有用的人脉。
下午的主题沙龙亦是相同的光景，两人奔波在不同的会议厅，谷雨声努力地打量着周围每个人，却始终没能攀谈上。
回了几条消息，下滑到游决的对话框，倪夏看着最后的对话，强行抹除尴尬，假装无事发生。
content_en:
Ni Xia was still asleep, and when her consciousness was drifting between wakefulness and fuzzyness, the phone beside her pillow vibrated, driving away most of her sleepiness.
Gongbao chicken from Shujing, Yipin tofu from Haidailou, Wenzheng mountain bamboo shoots from Huiyunxuan, eight-treasure rice from Xiaoyan in Huaiyang...
Early the next morning, Ni Xia walked on the wet ground from the ground parking lot to the entrance of Jiangcheng Exhibition Center.
The opening ceremony of Jiangcheng Film Production and Broadcasting Annual Conference will be held here. Gu Yusheng got the tickets from a friend, and the two planned to sneak in and try their luck.
After all, there are many industry giants gathered in this kind of situation, and they all exchange their knowledge here, and maybe there will be an opportunity from heaven.
Ni Xia raised her eyebrows proudly and walked in side by side with Gu Yusheng, "I also ground myself a cup of coffee."
"If nothing unexpected happens next, grandpa's three million can guarantee my sleep quality for a while."
Ni Xia didn't understand for a moment and said "Ah" in confusion before she realized who the "husband" in her mouth meant.
Turning his head to meet Gu Yusheng's eyes, he murmured understandingly: "Who can't sleep well lying in the arms of fifty million people?"
Looking at the huge sign-in wall in front of him, Gu Yusheng raised his eyebrows and said, "Don't worry, after all, he is just plan B."
Gu Yusheng didn't show any timidity at all. She was already tall. She was wearing a shirt skirt and stood there holding a signature pen, looking like a young boss of a film company.
With such momentum, the on-site staff did not dare to neglect them and politely ushered them into the conference hall.
The ever-changing leadership speeches, industry achievements display, and the strategic cooperation signing ceremony lasted for more than two hours.
Ni Xia and Gu Yusheng were sitting in the corner again, surrounded by staff responsible for the opening ceremony, and had no access to useful contacts.
The theme salon in the afternoon also had the same scene. The two of them were running around in different conference halls. Gu Yusheng tried his best to look at everyone around him, but he still couldn't strike up a conversation.
After replying a few messages and scrolling down to You Jue's dialog box, Ni Xia looked at the last conversation, forcibly erasing the embarrassment and pretending that nothing happened.
